title: Message of the day
description: The banner the client shows on the login and character-select screens, optionally limited to a time window.

enabled.description: Whether the message is shown at all.

title.description: Short headline shown above the body.

severity.description: How prominently the message is styled.

starts_at.description: When the message begins to be shown, as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Absent means immediately.

ends_at.description: When the message stops being shown, as an RFC 3339 timestamp. Absent means indefinitely.
